resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources give 70 feet (the lookout page quotes 1961 and 1967 newspapers), 75 feet (family memoir) and about 65 feet overall (1959 survey). The record keeps 70 feet from the newspaper quotes.
The family memoir says the warden started about 1930; a 1967 newspaper item calls 1967 his 29th year, which points to about 1939. The first-staffed event is dated 1939 with a note.

sources.title: On Watch at Gould's Fire Tower

notes_for_editor: Only two sources. The standing status rests on an undated family memoir that says a family member still goes up in spring and fall. The height and warden start-year conflicts are recorded above. The brief's coordinates were not checked against the 1959 survey description (about 5.5 miles northwest of Gouldsboro, 0.5 mile west of PA 196). Verification fix: the landowner Mamie was Mary Hause, who married Maurice Gilpin in 1913, so the story now calls her Raymond's sister instead of Mamie Hause. Open conflict, not changed: the Altoona Mirror item of 4 August 1922, on the lookout page (cite 1), says two new towers 'will be established' that month, one near Newfoundland. That sits uneasily with the memoir's April 1922 build date; the story keeps April as the family's account.
